svg.title: Turn expertise into repeat contributions
svg.desc: Find relevant experts, agree on work, review their contribution, then offer suitable work again. First accepted production work activates an expert; accepted work in a later period shows retention. This is the target flow.

g.text: Find good people. Help them do useful work. Offer a reason to return.
The goal: activated and retained experts.
Target flow. Live task, payment and return events still need integration.
